rows.title: If the description changes in another tab or device while the STAR Optimizer is open, Apply puts the rewrite as loose text at the top of the description and leaves the original bullet in place
rows.summary: Now: at Apply, a saved Range that is no longer in the editor or no longer covers the text the optimizer opened on (a value adopted from another tab or a cloud pull collapsed it to the editor's start) is dropped; the statement is found again by its text in the new content (statementRange with the caret in each line, else a text node holding it) and replaced there. With no such statement left, the rewrite is added as a new bullet, never as loose text at offset 0.

rows.title: Job scanner reads figures with a unit other than K/M/B ('3x', '10x', '200ms', '#1', '1st') as missing keywords, and '+' writes them into Skills
rows.summary: Now: jobKeywordOf's figure rule (FIGURE in src/utils/atsChecker.js) also drops a number with a multiplier or unit (x, ms, s, sec, min, h, hr, kb/mb/gb/tb/pb), an ordinal (st/nd/rd/th), a range of them and a '#' rank, so '#1', '200ms', '10x', '3x', '2-3x', '16GB', '1st' are neither keywords nor missing keywords; S3, EC2, 5G, Web3, 3D, 2FA, C#, C++ stay keywords.

rows.title: Public résumé page keeps showing, and downloading, the previous résumé after the tab moves to another share link
rows.summary: Now: PublicResume keeps each read with the shareId it was for and shows it only for that link, so moving the tab to another /r/<id> shows 'Loading the résumé…' (no Download PDF of the previous résumé) until the new copy is read; a download under way and its error are tagged with their link and never show on another. docs/knowledge/05-state-auth-sync.md says so.

issues: R5-HUNT7-OPTIMIZER-APPLY-AFTER-OUTSIDE-CHANGE: after an outside change, findStatement took the FIRST place the opened text was found, so a word selected in one bullet that an earlier bullet also has ('QA' in 'Handled QA for releases' below 'Led QA hiring'), or the second of two equal bullets, made Apply silently rewrite the other bullet. Fixed in d3bb5e8: openOptimizer records where the statement sat (anchorOf: its offset in the editor's text and 40 characters either side); at Apply every candidate (statementRange with the caret in each line, and every occurrence inside a text node) is scored by the text around it, then by distance from the old place, a whole statement winning a tie. Test tests/pdf/r5hunt7-optimizer-apply-anchor.test.mjs (fail 2 without, pass with).
review.notes: Checked each fix against origin/claude/r4-green. ATS: the FIGURE rule sits in jobKeywordOf (read by extractJobKeywords and its phrase reader); the module-level const is only read at call time, so no TDZ; S3/EC2/5G/Web3/3D/2FA/C#/C++ are guarded by the test. Minor, left as is: the lean-manufacturing term '5S' now reads as a figure (seconds) and is no longer a keyword. Public page: each read is tagged with its shareId, the busy state and error with their link, and the finally clears only its own download; A->B->A before B settles shows A's own earlier read, which is right. Optimizer: covers() catches the browser's collapse to (el, 0) that the old el.contains check let through; split-item statements (target + removals) compare by the same flat toString as at open. Fail-first runs of the original commits confirmed green (36634593821 for ATS and public page; 36635420101 for the optimizer after 97824a0 corrected its third case). Area run 36636188573 on d3bb5e8: 57-optimizer-statement, both 104-r5-opt-sw-wt-02 files, r5hunt3-richtext-outside-value, both r5hunt7 optimizer files, the r5hunt7 public-page and ATS tests, Playwright bullet-optimizer.spec, build and lint. No accessibility issue noted.
